primary_metric.name: median-of-3 tc vs records; confirmed records

attempts.hypothesis: global FM improvement of the waist cut + two-sided rebuild jumps between bipartitions SA cannot reach
attempts.causal_note: THREE CONFIRMED RECORDS (ksg 36.963, surfacecode 47.404, reg3_1000 131.068); sycamore missed the bar by 0.001; rqc base median beat, confirmation failed. Inversion: the frontier waist is NEVER a globally minimal cut (hundreds of calls, zero WAIST-MIN) — cuts are sparse, not near-clique; fixing pays exactly on separable networks

attempts.hypothesis: a diversity-maintained elite pool extends the productive-relink window past the collapse point
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED with the machinery working: distance floor held at max, reinjection functioning, and wins STILL died at relink 7-12 — basin complementarity is a small reservoir independent of pool policy; recombination family (046-049-055) closed

attempts.hypothesis: Tamaki's positive-instance principle transfers: few feasible low-boundary blocks -> completed exact DP on simplified real instances
attempts.causal_note: FALSIFIED: states explode past 1e5-1e6 within a few bits of min_w on all 6 instances (oracle-certified exact DP, 400 brute-forced graphs). Byproduct: connectivity-restricted block fusion is provably WRONG (outer-product counterexample)

reflection.review: Global-information batch. 054 waist surgery became the campaign's second pillar: three confirmed records (ksg, surfacecode, reg3_1000) with airtight rebuild attribution, plus the inversion that SA-refined waists are ALWAYS globally improvable (fixing them pays exactly on separable networks). 055 closed the recombination family with a three-attempt causal chain; 056 falsified the Tamaki transfer with oracle-certified blow-up curves. Final board: attempts hold 5/10 tc records + 2/3 TTF records.
reflection.evidence:
- 054 report: records confirmed median-of-3 + worse-of-two on quiet machine; fixed-work sub-anneals collapsed variance 0.8->0.08 bits.
- 055: distance floor held at 6 throughout, wins died at relink 7-12 anyway.
- 056: BLOCK-DP-CURVE lines on 6 instances; oracle test 400 graphs; outer-product counterexample.
- rqc_97_m24 repelled its third mechanism (base median beat, confirm failed).
reflection.lessons: Global information wins as moves-over-incumbent (surgery) or input (simplification); loses as search control, enumeration, or population policy. Expander vs separable networks now cleanly characterizes where local search suffices. rqc/nqueens need a bounds thread, not more optimizer attempts.
reflection.literature: FM surgery on an SA-optimal tree's dominant cut (vs FM tree CONSTRUCTION, which failed in 005/037/041) appears novel; block-DP blow-up quantifies folklore; outer-product counterexample sharpens netcon pruning claims.
reflection.next: None authorized — rounds exhausted. Recommend write-up: two-pillar algorithm story + composite + 20 mechanism-bounded negatives; optional bounds thread and omeco PR.

lessons.observation: the SA frontier's waist is never a globally minimal balanced cut
lessons.root_cause: one-leaf rewrites cannot jump between bipartitions; FM on the tensor graph finds 3-12-bit-cheaper cuts every call
lessons.evidence: 054: hundreds of surgery calls, zero WAIST-MIN, on all 6 instances
lessons.implication: waist surgery is a real transferable mechanism; where it pays is characterized by separability

lessons.observation: basin complementarity is a small reservoir (~10 recombinations), independent of pool diversity
lessons.root_cause: re-diversified elites are individually good but no longer complementary to the incumbent's remaining slack
lessons.evidence: 055: floor held at max, wins died at relink 7-12 as in 046/049
lessons.implication: recombination family closed; budget belongs in per-elite descent

lessons.observation: the PID 'few feasible blocks' premise fails for flop minimization
lessons.root_cause: low-open-boundary connected subsets are astronomically many just above min_w, unlike low-width separators in treewidth
lessons.evidence: 056 blow-up curves on 6 instances with an oracle-certified DP
lessons.implication: exact-method boundary quantified; certification of the new records needs bounds, not enumeration
